description.value: Ray Lyn Motel is a small motel on the outskirts of Trail, BC, offering standard queen-bed rooms and kitchenette units suited to multi-night stays. It sits a short drive from downtown Trail and is roughly 15 minutes from Red Mountain Ski Resort, placing it in the heart of the Kootenay region. Rooms include in-room fridge and microwave, and the property has a seasonal outdoor BBQ area and gazebo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides room details, amenities, and contact info. Wi-Fi is confirmed as 'Complimentary Wifi' listed for all room types on the /rooms page. No mention of bike storage, laundry, breakfast, or any cycling-specific services anywhere on the site. Phone, address, and email on the website match OSM tags exactly, confirming contact details.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active motel with a functioning website, confirmed contact details, and room listings — a valid accommodation stop for touring cyclists in the Trail/Kootenay area.

wow_evidence: small motel... seasonal outdoor BBQ area and gazebo
